# mv: rename a variable in a group declaration
mv X NewX
-- x.go --
package m

var (
	X = 42
	Y = 43
)

func F() int { return X + Y }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 package m

 var (
-	X = 42
-	Y = 43
+	NewX = 42
+	Y    = 43
 )

-func F() int { return X + Y }
+func F() int { return NewX + Y }
